nom: Avène Cicalfate Restorative Hand Cream for Dry Cracked Skin 3.3 oz

avis.titre: My 75 year old hands appear softer and younger!
avis.texte: Avene Cicalfate Restorative Hand cream leaves my hands feeling very soft! A little goes a long way, I have had mine for a year. Soon I will be purchasing another tube. Yes, it is a little pricey for a hand cream, but does the job better then any other product I have used on my hands. Highly recommend this hand cream if you have dry, sensitive skin. It also has no added fragrance which I really appreciate!

Such a great product. Really works well on chapped, dry hands during winter or to maintain healthy skin in other conditions. There really isn't a scent, it smells kind of plastic-y but that's fine with me when the results are so good. Hard to find in my area, so happy Amazon carries this brand.
Dries down almost to a light powder finish. Not the most moisturizing lotion but does the job. Has a light chemical smell.

I've never had an Avene product that smelled bad. This smells so bad I almost can not use it. Just foul and the smell doesn't go away even hours later. I gave it a good rating though because it works. So I'm a little torn as I've never really found a product that worked. Sigh

avis.titre: Leaves your hands nice and smooth
avis.texte: Such a great hand cream! All you need a small amount and it goes such a long way. Not greasy at all and great price

avis.titre: One of the Best Hand Creams
avis.texte: I love this hand cream! It is one of the best I’ve tried. It feels nourishing, works really well for dry hands, and I like that it feels gentle without harsh ingredients. The price is also excellent. Highly recommended!
This made my hands drier and seemed to make them crack and become more scaly.

avis.titre: La migliore crema per le mani secche
avis.texte: Crema straordinaria che uso da anni, molto nutriente per le mani secche, assorbe perfettamente e nutre la pelle. Davvero eccezionale

Mi esposa se la empezó aplicar en la cesaría, cirugía que fue en octubre 2023, no lleva un mes, y la cicatriz empezó aclarear y desbaneser, fué muy buena estrategia comprar dos de una vez. Y pienso comprar de nuevo para continuar el tratamiento y tener para otras situaciones que se presenten.

avis.titre: Ma rosacée et mes rougeurs au visage ont disparus
avis.texte: Belle découverte. Je l’utilise comme crème pour le visage suite à une recommandation et depuis plus de rougeur et plus de début de rosacée, yeah! Ce produit prend officiellement place dans mes top produits!
